# 网关代理

# 1. 登录(获取token):

> ``/oauth/token``

* 请求方式: POST (返回格式为: application/json)
* 请求参数([]中为用户输入变量,其他为常量): 
```
{
   "username": "username",
   "password": "password"
}
```
* 返回格式:
```
{
    "success": true,
    "errCode": null,
    "errMsg": null,
    "data": {
        "access_token": "eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJhY2NvdW50Q29kZSI6IjExMDk0NzQzIiwiZW50TmFtZSI6IuWkp-.G8hHTKyXDgoWhUmUtLkS0QTAXxQpTZcdAquXdBwobOtLsvUF61RAirYBY8p6SIy0F2WIUsvh4pUXFhYTq7oQQFDo0bAZGJ8KIPBlrVuQvZSaAva2WsMTaK5dm4Rd3KnuW0bS2ezmxK1AGg1ekCkQfdAW8OhAtaJm5WabMoTjt4KLYqEa25zNub_lyRCleuRkYHfD3mgbG9ApQ8oIvS3IukP97I-jzFS35-6af6W36ScsuLQ7Uv6iN4DESoFTKDztS_lRptNRkCX6pNeAml97LURRvooXRG5AgUd_CTd_56CYV3CTs_Ab-Ry65sjTdGHAASu9fgU_E-2Tf2LC92wixA",
        "token_type": "bearer",
        "refresh_token": "eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJhY2NvdW50Q29kZSI6IjExMDk0NzQzIiwiZW50TmFtZSI6IuWkp-.A82GFtAZMazfnEX3UgzwR6uhIcmS3jiqwPrG5GoHJcNZ1VTggUVsl6JE8lJA5iNpD9Uk6O8dstjVaC5LgD_eVAWi69guWbdkGH2UlnlUxDKBnpwRaKM_Ug0x2AG9PdKIuj0g-DsQXrwjk2BAD-6NKeI4I1_nSE65Q6wWN8yPVdI2UTFg1ZUMWDUbIwCJVgQ9oRvjXvxSzuDk-pFN0-XjHVdOmaRJW4pCZbga-cJGa3UuyQdMQ07llR0vK8-z1y2UZk10ggM0k5WKuvslA8_Cd_nccdX5WgnbMbLklnMHH4JpweWuRcWj_Pnt-1YE85PqDFWpla4xfE2vjDWDbxrPEw",

        "entName": "大乔",

        "accountName": "18073112120",

        "jti": "6f290ad1-fcba-4558-8000-f40867f7cab8"
    },
    "exception": null
}
```
* 变量说明:
> ``access_token`` 为生成的用户jwt授权token,有效时长2小时. ``refresh_token`` 为刷新token,有效时长24小时,可以用来刷新``access_token``
* token 解密 - 可选:
```
var jwt = require('jsonwebtoken');
// get the decoded payload ignoring signature, no secretOrPrivateKey needed
var decoded = jwt.decode(token);
 
// get the decoded payload and header
var decoded = jwt.decode(token, {complete: true});
console.log(decoded.header);
console.log(decoded.payload)
```
* 示例:
```
curl --location --request POST '/oauth/token' \
--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
--data-raw '{
    "username":"18674492943",
    "password":"admin1"
}'
```

# 2. 刷新token(更新``access_token`` , 或者切换账套)

> ``/oauth/refresh``

* 请求方式: POST (返回格式为json)
* 请求参数([]中为用户输入变量,其他为常量):
* 如果需要切换账套增加``usercode``参数
```
{
    "usercode": "要切换的用户代码"
    "refresh_token": "eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..YVBW3ELfxvy6dhY8hXSxhXGChkcFcOKft-E9wlmNbTCLMeUeO7_riZclGGZbsHwJZBfNzZqj2hRWRJDa4B3d-a00ndmkWTpBWGSLHe86SnObQrAJYJfcb7O6v6XGr_0MwRGj9ZF_q-eGK8gKAhgeS9bnrdf7SVs6gBNTe6J3Klj9WESou69aCA4N5lVdUiFonAcGIW9CC_qypo3AKV2_XYaouQKt4iKaqyddG_6qVrONVnDguUhE5vyhtakF6866vv5BVP4qitctnkM2dX2SuiuXjG9-_GUtu-La5gUkRtE04niYAvwjxwZzclHy5zTQYxqcfa6yT-J_teUx26TAjg"
}
```
* 返回格式同上
* 示例:
```
curl --location --request POST '/oauth/refresh' \
--header 'Accept: application/json' \
--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
--data-raw '{
    "usercode": "fsdfsdfdsfwef"
    "refresh_token": "eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..."
}'
```

# 3. 使用``access_token`` 请求后端资源
> 方式一: 接口请求中,header中增加 ``Authorization``, 值格式为 ``Bearer [access_token]`` ,注意中间有个空格.
> 方式二: 接口url中增加请求参数``access_token``,值为access_token的值。
* 示例一:
```
curl --location --request GET '/resource-pc/test' \
--header 'Accept: application/json' \
--header 'Content-Type: application/json'
--header 'Authorization: Bearer [access_token]'
```
* 示例二:
```
curl --location --request GET '/resource-pc/test?access_token=[access_token]' \
--header 'Accept: application/json' \
--header 'Content-Type: application/json'
```

# 4. 注销``access_token``
> ``/oauth/revoke``

* 请求方式: GET 请求
* 请求方式一, 保证header信息中包含 ``Authorization`` 即可.
* 请求方式二, url中增加``access_token``参数
* 返回格式:
```
{
    "success": true,
    "errCode": null,
    "errMsg": null,
    "data": "登出成功!",
    "exception": null
}
```
* 示例一:
```
curl --location --request GET '/oauth/token/revoke' \
--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
--header 'Accept: application/json' \
--header 'Authorization: Bearer [access_token]'
```

* 示例二:
```
curl --location --request GET '/oauth/token/revoke?access_token=[access_token]' \
--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
--header 'Accept: application/json' \
```

# 5. 获取jwt的公钥(用于验签) 可选支持
> 开发环境: ``https://api-mlf-dev.yj2025.com/gateway-oauth2-server/oauth/token_key`` </br>
> 测试环境url: ``https://api-test.yj2025.com/gateway-oauth2-server/oauth/token_key``

* 请求方式: GET
* 返回格式: 
```
{
    "success": true,
    "errCode": null,
    "errMsg": null,
    "data": {
        "alg": "SHA256withRSA",
        "value": "-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----\\n-----END PUBLIC KEY-----"
    },
    "exception": null
}
```
